steps.tx: **Gaucher disease** (glucocerebrosidase absent) is the commonest sphingolipidosis: glucocerebroside laden macrophages with wrinkled tissue paper cytoplasm pack marrow, liver and spleen, causing cytopenias, bone pain and crises, Erlenmeyer flask femora from failed remodelling, and growth failure. Neuronopathic forms (types II and III) add brain disease; type I spares brain and answers to enzyme replacement or substrate reduction, a treatability examiners emphasise.
steps.say: Gaucher disease packs marrow, liver and spleen with wrinkled storage macrophages, causing cytopenias and bone crises. Type one spares brain and answers to enzyme replacement. Neuronopathic forms add brain disease.

vis.alt: Pink marrow biopsy shows crowded swollen cells with wrinkled pale cytoplasm labelled as Gaucher cells.
vis.caption: Marrow packed with wrinkled storage cells, Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Niemann-Pick A and B** (acid sphingomyelinase absent) store sphingomyelin in foam cells: type A adds relentless neurodegeneration, cherry red spot and death in early childhood, while type B spares brain but enlarges liver and spleen and scars lungs. Niemann-Pick C is a different cholesterol trafficking disease (NPC1/2) with vertical gaze palsy, ataxia and cataplexy, and must never be merged with A/B in answers.
steps.say: Niemann-Pick A adds neurodegeneration and early death, while type B spares brain. Niemann-Pick C is a separate cholesterol trafficking disease with vertical gaze palsy and must never be merged with A or B.

steps.tx: **Tay-Sachs disease** (hexosaminidase A alpha subunit absent) stores GM2 ganglioside in neurons: exaggerated startle (hyperacusis), developmental regression after three to six months, cherry red spot (pale swollen retina around normal red fovea), seizures and death in childhood, without liver or spleen enlargement. Sandhoff (beta subunit) adds visceromegaly because both A and B hexosaminidases fail. Ashkenazi carrier screening is the classic prevention model.
steps.say: Tay-Sachs stores GM2 in neurons with hyperacusis, regression and cherry red spot, without liver enlargement. Sandhoff adds visceromegaly because both hexosaminidases fail. Carrier screening is the prevention model.

vis.alt: Comparison of Tay-Sachs and Niemann-Pick diseases highlighting organomegaly differences and cherry red spot findings.
vis.caption: Clinical distinction between Tay-Sachs and Niemann-Pick diseases.

steps.tx: **Fabry disease** (alpha-galactosidase A, X linked) stores globotriaosylceramide in vessels, kidney, heart and nerves: childhood burning acroparaesthesias and heat intolerance, bathing trunk angiokeratomas, cornea verticillata, then proteinuria, renal failure, left ventricular hypertrophy and strokes. Females range widely by lyonisation. Enzyme replacement and the chaperone migalastat (amenable mutations) make early recognition genuinely outcome changing.
steps.say: Fabry disease stores lipid in vessels, kidney, heart and nerves, causing burning limb pain, angiokeratomas and later renal and cardiac failure. Early recognition changes outcome with replacement or chaperone therapy.

steps.tx: White matter sphingolipidoses present with regression and neuropathy rather than visceromegaly: **Krabbe disease** (galactocerebrosidase, psychosine toxicity, globoid cells) devastates infants with irritability, spasticity and peripheral neuropathy, while metachromatic leukodystrophy (arylsulfatase A, sulfatide storage) toddlers lose gait then speech and cognition, with metachromatic granules in urine and slowed nerve conduction. Newborn screening plus early stem cell or gene approaches are shifting both prognoses in selected cases.
steps.say: Krabbe devastates infants with irritability and neuropathy, while metachromatic leukodystrophy toddlers lose gait then cognition. Newborn screening plus early stem cell approaches are shifting both prognoses in selected cases.

steps.tx: **Cherry red spot** reasoning closes the set: present in Tay-Sachs, Niemann-Pick A, GM1 gangliosidosis and sialidosis (swollen ganglion cells pale the retina), characteristically absent in Gaucher and Fabry teaching lists. Pair it with visceromegaly (present: Niemann-Pick; absent: Tay-Sachs) and inheritance (Fabry X linked, rest recessive) and the sphingolipid table answers itself. Farber (ceramidase, hoarse voice, joint nodules) completes the named set in one line.
steps.say: Cherry red spot appears in Tay-Sachs and Niemann-Pick A, characteristically absent in Gaucher teaching lists. Pair it with visceromegaly and inheritance, and the sphingolipid table answers itself.
